title.hr: Dugi dani, kratke noći: turnaround i vožnja kući
title.en: Long days, short nights: turnaround and the drive home

concept.hr: Prekovremeno jede odmor, put jede san: dug raste do vožnje kući
concept.en: Overruns eat the rest, travel eats the sleep: the debt builds to the drive home

summary.hr: Tjedan poziva i wrapova: dani idu preko, put do seta, san i dug kroz tjedan, sati budnosti na vožnji kući i što to prekida.
summary.en: A week of calls and wraps: days run over, travel to set, sleep and debt through the week, hours awake at the drive home, and the fixes.
